program.title: BEng in Electronic Engineering
uncertain: total_required_credits (73.0) is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all non-optional groups, using the lower bound for credit ranges (e.g. 9-10, 4-5, 4-6).
The ELEC/MATH fundamental block requires 3 courses out of 5; the lower bound (9 credits) assumes three 3-credit courses. Actual credits may be higher if ELEC 2600 (4) is chosen.
The elective requirement (21 credits) is any ELEC 3000-level or above course; the PDF provides no fixed course list, so the courses array is empty.
The Research Option is optional and excluded from total_required_credits.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 ELEC (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the 2026-27 intake curriculum.

groups.name: Engineering Fundamental Course(s)
groups.note: Note: ELEC 2600 OR MATH 2011 OR MATH 2111 OR MATH 2350 OR MATH 2351 (3 courses out of 5)

courses.name: Probability and Random Processes in Engineering
Applied Linear Algebra and Differential Equations
Honors Object-Oriented Programming and Data Structures

groups.name: Engineering Fundamental Course(s)
groups.note: Note: [(MATH 1013 OR MATH 1023) AND (MATH 1014 OR MATH 1024)] OR [MATH 1020]

courses.name: A System View of Communications: from Signals to Packets
Introduction to Computer Organization and Design

groups.name: Required Course(s)
groups.note: Note: ELEC 4900 OR ELEC 4901 OR ELEC 4910 (Students taking the Research Option must take ELEC 4901)

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: ELEC 3000-level or above Electives (Courses of the subject and level as specified, out of which at least 2 courses must be at 4000-level. ELEC 4940 cannot be used to count towards this elective requirement.) The PDF does not list specific courses for this requirement (any ELEC 3000-level or above course).

groups.name: Research Option Required Course(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL. Students may opt to graduate with or without the Research Option. Students taking it must also take ELEC 4901 (already in Required group). Not counted in total_required_credits.

groups.name: Research Option Elective(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL (see Research Option above). Advanced Elective Courses approved by advisor (at least one UROP course taken prior to the commencement of Final Year Thesis, and one PG-level course). Not counted in total_required_credits.
